note_en: 虽然……，但是…… is "although..., ...": 虽然每天都要在街上跑来跑去，但是能听到这么多不同的故事…… "although I'm out running around the streets every day, getting to hear so many different stories..." English allows only one connector, so "although... but" is a mistake there, yet Chinese normally uses both halves together. 但是 can be shortened to 但 (虽然设计工作有时很辛苦，但……) or the 虽然 dropped, but the pair is the standard pattern.
